A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same VRGA research and provide readable text, equations, figures, and tables. All ten pages of each were inspected; both end with references and contain no appendices.

before.justification: v1 reports original TextVQA attention analyses and head-masking experiments, plus VRGA evaluations on HaloQuest, HallusionBench, and MMStar.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical analyses and benchmark results in Figures 1–4 and Tables 1–3.

M1.justification: Section 4 retains the same entropy–focus head selection, background-attention subtraction, region-token selection, and attention reweighting. No algorithm component or inference procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both versions use TextVQA for attention analyses and head masking, and HaloQuest, HallusionBench, and MMStar for benchmark evaluation. No dataset, task, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Table 3 retains exactly the same model-specific baseline, CCoT, and ICoT comparisons. Table 2 retains the same unmodified baseline, Random Masking, and Low-Visual Masking comparisons.

E3.justification: The 1,450-sample and 1,500-sample TextVQA analyses, model configurations, head-masking settings, and correctness, irrelevance, and comprehensive-score metrics are unchanged.

E4.justification: Both retain the same prompting comparisons, layer- and head-level attention analyses, qualitative examples, and head-masking experiment. No ablation, robustness test, or supplementary analysis changes.

E5.justification: Table 1 retains mean and standard-deviation reporting for regression statistics, and Figures 2–3 retain the same range and interquartile shading descriptions. No run-count, seed, or uncertainty-reporting information changes.

E6.justification: All result entries in Tables 1–3 and all plotted findings are unchanged. For example, Table 3 reports Qwen2.5-VL-3B+VRGA HaloQuest accuracy 59.03%, score 0.488, and irrelevance 0.405 in both versions.

T1.justification: The RRAR, image-attention ratio, entropy, and entropy–focus definitions, along with Equations 1–9 and the comprehensive-score formula, are unchanged. No formal assumption, derivation, or proof is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about reasoning-induced attention dispersion and training-free VRGA restoring visual grounding and improving reasoning.

C2.justification: Interpretations of attention dispersion, visual-head specialization, masking results, and benchmark performance are unchanged. Neither version adds a new limitation or applicability qualification.

D1.justification: The code-access footnote and disclosed implementation and experimental details are identical. The new acknowledgments identify institutional support but provide no additional technical or reproducibility information.

R1.justification: Both retain the same 31 reference entries and the same related-work discussion and novelty positioning. A citation back-reference changes page number because of reflow.

P1.justification: v2 changes Yuanzheng Ma’s affiliation from National University of Defense Technology to Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School and adds acknowledgments after Section 6. The scientific prose and section order remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Table 1 moves from PDF page 6 to page 5, Figure 1 shifts upward with the shorter affiliation block, and text and equation spacing reflow. All five figure images, table structures, and captions remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 updates an affiliation, adds acknowledgments, and makes minor layout changes. The method, evidence, claims, explanations, and reproducibility information are unchanged, so the revision establishes no meaningful overall quality gain or decline.
